post.description: 撤销当前 StuHelper 会话。Casdoor 槽位忙时跳过上游注销。若在短时限内收到 Casdoor 成功确认，upstream_ended 为 true。 已撤销会话再次请求返回 401。

upstream_ended.description: True only if Casdoor confirms the single end-session request within its deadline.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Omit for the regular Casdoor sign-in page. Only qq is accepted, once only; empty, repeated and other values return invalid_input. The server maps qq to its configured Casdoor provider name.
